body: Fix spec android-macos-e2e-fixes, grounding: cosmetic root causes (read at d36b748, not yet probed).U+000AU+000AU+002D C2: the timer pill and camera picker are separate Positioned children sharing top:16 (video_recorder_sheet.dart:234-297). The macOS sheet is always 636 px, so they overlap by about 11 px. Android at 411 dp is within 5-10 dp of the same collision.U+000AU+002D C3: the card shows the stored stopwatch duration while the player shows the file's own duration (video_body.dart:517-527). Both round down. The stopwatch misses native start and stop latency on both platforms. Which value is true is unconfirmed (needs ffprobe on real clips).U+000AU+002D C4: the card actions pill lives in a window-wide OverlayPortal (log_actions_pill.dart:468-470) and is shown on hover. When the day sheet scrolls a search result into view under a still pointer, the card above takes the hover, and its pill draws over the header, clickable, outside the list's clip. This is the same family as Android AC1.U+000AU+002D C5: three fixed plurals: mood_tally_chips.dart:38, journal_data_controller.dart:42-43, and note_semantics.dart:12 (table label).U+000AU+002D C8: the voice recorder writes voice_U+003Cms>.m4a to the temp folder, and save copies it without deleting it. Reclaim space and Delete all never see it, so recordings survive Delete all, which is a privacy issue. Twins: macOS video output.mp4 and thumbnails; Android CameraX files, video discard, and image_picker cache copies. On macOS, photos are the user's own original files and must never be deleted.U+000AU+002D The silent first mood on a past day has no code cause (every path plays the sound); the headset during the Discord call is the likely explanation.
